resources.string: These entries track settings still to integrate. They do not change settings, connect services, or start transfers.
Choose Library, the last notebook, or the last book. Extend the original Library / Last Notebook preference to remember the Reading or Writing shelf.

Whole-library backup and restore: notebooks, books, original book bytes, annotations, and settings. The old notebook-only backup is not a complete mixed-library backup. Passwords must remain excluded.
Explicit import from an original ForestNote backup into Alexandria, with a preview, validation, and a recoverable rollback. Never silently replace either library.
Show storage use, keep books offline, and remove only replaceable local caches. Distinguish removing a local copy from deleting a book everywhere.

Enable or disable sync; edit the server URL, username, and password; save and verify the connection through the shared owner. One author, multiple devices. Library Setup remains the current enrollment and recovery route.
Sync interval and sync when returning to Library, adapted to the shared queue and foreground lifecycle. Do not start the original notebook-only sync controller.
Expose existing asset-transfer policy, large-book downloads, offline availability, and retry controls alongside the shared library.
Bring existing shared sync history, reconciliation, and upgrade diagnostics into this page without changing library identity.

Off / local-only, OpenAI-compatible, or Anthropic-compatible; base URL, vision model, encrypted API key, explicit Save, and Test Endpoint. Upload a page only after an explicit transcription action. Reader annotation support needs its own scope and consent.

Recognition language selection and on-demand downloads work now. Still to connect: installed-language inventory, downloads of additional models without selecting them, and safe removal of models not in use.

Reader already recognizes missing saved annotations. Add a unified Reader / Writer queue, first-setup model preparation, whole-library Writer backfill, and explicit re-recognition when language changes. Preserve existing text unless replacement is requested.
Collection URL, username, password, explicit Save Credentials, and Test Connection. Keep app-password guidance and encrypted credentials. Reader-to-task links must use stable document anchors.
Show pending and failed tasks, retry or drain the queue, and cancel or delete individual queued tasks. Wire the shared owner before enabling controls.
Auto-empty after a chosen number of days; zero means never. Extend retention and recovery to books and annotations as well as notebooks, respecting sync and asset references.
Expose the existing fastest-ink preference on supported Viwoods devices and apply it safely to Reader and Writer. Hide or explain unsupported hardware controls.
Enable diagnostic logs in Downloads and offer an explicit export. Keep credentials and book or notebook content out of diagnostic bundles.
Device-specific refresh defaults, page-turn cleanup, Clear Ghosting, and compact-device chrome scaling. These belong to the device, not the synced page geometry.
Font, font size, letter spacing, word spacing, and paragraph spacing. Define app defaults versus per-book overrides; reflow only after Apply Reading Settings. No sentence-spacing control.
Initial writing-region height, shared pen and thickness defaults, and highlight presentation. Preserve existing ink coordinates and anchor boundaries.
Preserve image aspect ratios, including covers and title pages. Keep long-press zoom and an explicit exit. No stretching to fill the screen.
Reading direction, page-turn gestures, position display, and references between stable notebook and book anchors. Never turn pages while editing ink.
Collect reader, ink, font, UI, and model dependencies and their licenses for the Alexandria distribution.
The new name is settled. Package identity, repository split, and import from ForestNote will be handled as an explicit fork checkpoint; this build still uses its existing qualification identity.
